cohort: 200 women who underwent repeat Caesarean section at a Government General Hospital in Rajamahendravaram, India, between August 2022 and July 2023.
finding: Adhesions were the most common intraoperative difficulty (83.72%) encountered during repeat caesarean sections, followed by thinned out lower uterine segment (37.2%), haemorrhage (10.9%), placenta previa (8.13%), and extension of the uterine incision (6%).
